title: 大阪・和泉の母娘刺殺事件、娘殺害の疑いで５１歳男を逮捕…「持ってきた包丁で数回刺した」元交際相手か
extracted_text:
大阪府和泉市の集合住宅の一室で４月、住人の母娘が刺殺された事件で、府警は１日、堺市堺区新在家町東の無職、杉平輝幸容疑者（５１）を娘に対する殺人容疑で逮捕した。娘の元交際相手とみられる。容疑を認め、「持ってきた包丁で首などを数回刺して殺した」と供述している。府警は杉平容疑者が母親の殺害にも関与したとみて、動機など詳しい経緯を調べる。
殺害されたのは、この部屋で２人暮らしをしていた和泉市鶴山台の無職、村上和子さん（７６）と、長女で社会福祉士の裕加さん（４１）。発表によると、杉平容疑者は４月８日未明、村上さん方で、裕加さんの首を刃物で突き刺すなどして失血死させた疑い。
府警によると、同日未明の現場近くの防犯カメラ映像に、うろつく人物が映っていた。カメラ映像を収集・分析する「リレー方式」で追跡し、杉平容疑者が浮上したという。
府警は関係者の証言などから、杉平容疑者が過去に裕加さんと交際していたとみており、トラブルの有無を調べる。ストーカーなどの相談はなかったという。
捜査関係者によると、それぞれの首や頭、背中などに１０か所以上の刺し傷や切り傷があった。裕加さんには顔を殴られた痕もあった。２人ともパジャマ姿だった。
裕加さんは２０１７年頃から和泉市内の病院で勤務し、患者の退院支援を担当していたという。
（詳しくはこちら）
translated_text: In April, a mother and daughter were found stabbed to death in an apartment at a housing complex in Izumi City, Osaka Prefecture. On the 1st, prefectural police arrested Tatsu 51, a 51-year-old unemployed suspect living in New Home Town East, Sakai City, Sakai Ward, on suspicion of murdering the daughter. He is believed to have been the daughter's former partner. The suspect has admitted to the charges, stating, 'I stabbed her in the neck and other areas several times with a knife I brought and killed her.' Police believe the suspect was also involved in the mother's killing and are investigating the motive and other details. The victims were Murakami Tomoko, 76, unemployed and Yuka, 41, a social welfare worker, both living together in the apartment in Tsuruyama-dai, Izumi City. According to the announcement, there are concerns that the suspect may have a financial motive. On April 8, Yuka was stabbed in the neck with a sharp object, causing her to lose blood and die. The suspect was identified through analysis of security camera footage from the area, showing a suspicious person wandering near the scene. The police used a 'relay method' to collect and analyze camera footage and track the suspect, leading to his identification. The police are also investigating whether there had been any previous disputes between the suspect and Yuka, based on witness testimony. There were no reports of stalking or similar complaints. Investigation sources indicate both victims had over 10 stab or cut wounds on their necks, heads, and backs. Yuka also had marks on her face from being beaten. Both were wearing pajamas. Yuka had been working at a hospital in Izumi City since around 2017, handling patient discharge support.
title_en: Mother-Daughter Stabbing in Izumi, Osaka: 51-Year-Old Man Arrested on Suspicion of Daughter's Murder — 'Stabbed Her Multiple Times in Neck With Knife He Brought,' Former Partner
